entities.summary: Villarrica del Espíritu Santo, is a city in Paraguay. Located in the middle of the Eastern Region of Paraguay, it is the capital and most populous city of Guairá Department. Villarrica is a human settlement in South America, established around 1570. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
